text:
olga: Heads-up: cutting a region-by-region rollout for redwood-v2.3.0 in 10m. Order US->EU->APAC. Canary 4%, pin 10m each.

mike: Will run headroom and queue checks now.

sre-jun: Preflight: US free GPUs 60/80 (75%), EU 40/60 (66%), APAC 12/30 (40%) — APAC below 60% threshold.

olga: If APAC <60% we'll either warm +2 nodes or set APAC canary to 2%. Proceeding with US first.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by olga. release=redwood-v2.3.0 regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=0.04 pin=10m. /deploy status 1750000001

mike: US canary s-701 started. p95 ok, 500s normal.

deploy-bot: US pin complete and healthy. Starting EU canary s-702.

sre-jun: Triggering warmpool +2 APAC. ETA ~4m. After warmup APAC expected ~52% free.

olga: If warmup <65% we'll run APAC at 2% canary for an extended 15m pin. Update me when warmup done.

sre-jun: Warmpool finished: APAC free GPUs 18/32 (56%). Below 65%. Setting APAC canary to 2% per plan.

olga: Starting APAC canary 2% (s-703) with 15m pin. /deploy start --release redwood-v2.3.0 --region apac --canary 0.02 --pin 15m

deploy-bot: APAC canary s-703 started. Observability: https://console/obs/s-703

deploy-bot: :warning: s-703 shows kv_cache_miss_rate spike and 500s at +3m.

mike: Logs show shard routing mismatch on host apac-node-4. Initiating rollback for s-703. /deploy rollback --slice s-703 --reason "shard routing mismatch"
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. APAC pin released.

olga: Holding APAC rollout. Opening incident INC-2026-210 and delegating: sre-jun to isolate hosts & config-sync; mike to prepare hotfix. EU/US remain on v2.3.0. Will reconvene in 30m.
tara: Added incident and linked logs. Will update here once staging smoke is green.
